nodes.name: ProjectLoadRequest
nodes.func: P1 frozen UI-captured request retains every positional admission field and adds default-None captured generations; product requests always populate both and workers read no live counters
examples: (EX-I3-039-C) admitted P-PAIR with current A=`7` and I=`4` → frozen request captures `7` and `4` before worker launch
(EX-I3-039-E) admitted P-PAIR-NOMAC with A=`7` and I=`4` → the same request contract captures both counters without a MAC-specific default
(EX-I3-048-F) P-ONLY request captures I=`4`, then a test-controlled UI change advances live I to `5` → request remains frozen at `4` for the already-running worker

nodes.name: PreparedProjectLoad
nodes.func: P2 frozen worker handoff carries prepared image/MAC bundles or legacy LoadedFile test values, plus one optional A2L-only Inc2 snapshot, without changing existing field order
examples: (EX-I3-039-C) captured A=`7`, I=`4` → image bundle expects `9`, `5` with no A2L snapshot; MAC bundle expects `10`, `6` with the load's single A2L snapshot
(EX-I3-039-E) captured A=`7`, I=`4` and no MAC → image bundle expects `9`, `5` and carries one A2L snapshot; mac is `None`
(EX-I3-046-A) captured A=`0`, I=`0` for P-ONLY → image=`None`, mac=`None`, and a2l_only expects `2`, `0` without a synthetic LoadedFile

nodes.name: ProjectLoadMixin._handle_load_project
nodes.func: P3 preserves cheap refusals, admission and busy order, captures both current generations into P1 on the UI thread, and starts the existing worker without path-only reload short-circuiting
examples: (EX-I3-039-D) admitted P-ONLY with A=`7`, I=`4` → one worker receives captured generations `7`, `4` and no image or MAC is fabricated
(EX-I3-047-B) the same project name and same.a2l path contain equal-size NEW bytes after OLD, with no clear → admission starts a fresh worker instead of treating path equality as content equality
(EX-I3-043-C) admitted P-ONLY starts the normal worker with captured generations → later producer failure remains on the existing project failure route, with no UI preparation fallback

nodes.name: ProjectLoadMixin._prepare_project_load
nodes.func: P4 parses and selects as before, prepares all product image/MAC bundles and A2L-only data off UI through F5 and the same Inc2 snapshot producer, uses stage-specific expected pairs, and propagates preparation exceptions without a candidate fallback
examples: (EX-I3-039-C) P-PAIR with A=`7`, I=`4` → image F5 uses prepare_a2l=`False` at `9`, `5`; MAC F5 uses prepare_a2l=`True` at `10`, `6`; Inc2 producer calls=`1`, UI constructions=`0`
(EX-I3-039-E) P-PAIR-NOMAC with A=`7`, I=`4` → image F5 uses prepare_a2l=`True` at `9`, `5`; Inc2 producer calls=`1`, mac=`None`, UI constructions=`0`
(EX-I3-039-D) P-ONLY with A=`7`, I=`4` → the Inc2 producer receives parsed A2L, image_mem_map=`None`, expected pair `9`, `4`; calls=`1`, synthetic LoadedFile count=`0`

(EX-I3-041-A) unexecuted oracle input for three P-PAIR runs has totals `44`, `45`, `46` seconds, all four phases present, and maximum tick lateness `100` ms → median=`45`, maximum=`46`, budget verdict=`True`
(EX-I3-041-A, total-negative) unexecuted totals `44`, `45`, `60` seconds with responsive ticks → median=`45` but individual maximum=`60`, so total-budget verdict=`False`

(EX-I3-041-B) unexecuted oracle input for three P-PAIR-NOMAC runs has totals `42`, `43`, `44` seconds and at least `3` ticks during a `0.20` second worker hold → median=`43`, maximum=`44`, responsiveness and budget verdict=`True`

(EX-I3-042-A) unexecuted oracle input for three P-ONLY runs has totals `43`, `44`, `45` seconds, admission/parse/preparation/install phases but no copy phase → median=`45`, maximum=`45`, budget verdict=`True`
(EX-I3-042-A, total-negative) unexecuted responsive P-ONLY hold of `61` seconds → individual duration bound verdict=`False` independently of tick results

(EX-I3-043-B) P-PAIR producer raises ValueError("PREPARE_CONTROL") → exception reaches the existing project failure route; PreparedProjectLoad candidate count=`0`, reset count=`0`, UI preparation count=`0`
(EX-I3-043-C) P-ONLY producer raises ValueError("PREPARE_CONTROL") → no A2L-only snapshot or candidate installs; cache/reset/widget/success counts=`0`

(EX-I3-043-D) P-PAIR-NOMAC producer raises ValueError("PREPARE_CONTROL") → the existing project failure route receives it; candidates=`0`, resets=`0`, UI preparations=`0`, MAC fabrications=`0`, successes=`0`
(EX-I3-047-B) same-path equal-size A2L NEW replaces OLD with a changed write timestamp → parsing and the single snapshot contain NEW markers, never a path-keyed OLD reuse
(EX-I3-047-C) same-path equal-size image NEW replaces OLD in P-PAIR → image/MAC preparation reads NEW image bytes and current A2L, never OLD image bytes
(EX-I3-047-D) same-path equal-size P-ONLY A2L NEW replaces OLD → a2l_only carries NEW tags/summary/definitions with expected post-reset pair, with no image input invented
(EX-I3-048-F) P-ONLY captured A=`7`, I=`4` → worker snapshot expects `9`, `4`; a later live I=`5` is not read or hidden by this worker

(EX-I3-048-G) test-constructed keyless P-PAIR image bundle at current A=`7`, I=`4` carries A2L expectation `8` instead of required `9` and a2l_enriched_key=`None` → P4 preserves the stale generation-only candidate for P5 pre-reset rejection without repair or producer repair

(EX-I3-048-H) test-constructed keyless P-PAIR image bundle carries image expectation `4` instead of required `5` and a2l_enriched_key=`None` → P4 preserves it for P5 pre-reset rejection; no enrichment key is required

nodes.name: ProjectLoadMixin._install_prepared_project
nodes.func: P5 preflights every product stage pair against current UI generations before reset or any candidate mutation, installs accepted prepared values with publish_a2l=False, installs A2L-only snapshots without LoadedFile synthesis, then publishes once after final project identity and before outcome
examples: (EX-I3-045-A) empty session A=`0`, I=`0` accepts P-PAIR → preflight image `2`, `1` and MAC `3`, `2`; reset/image/MAC publications=`0`; final F=`1` after pair `3`, `2` and before OUTCOME
(EX-I3-045-B) outgoing P-PAIR A=`7`, I=`4` accepts incoming P-PAIR → both stages preflight before reset; only incoming final pair `10`, `6` reaches final F=`1`, then OUTCOME

(EX-I3-045-C) empty session A=`0`, I=`0` accepts P-PAIR-NOMAC → image preflight expects `2`, `1`; reset/image publications=`0`, MAC fabrications=`0`, and exactly `1` final F sees image+A2L/project identity before OUTCOME
(EX-I3-046-A) empty session A=`0`, I=`0` accepts P-ONLY → preflight `2`, `0`, reset without F, A2L writer and prepared cache/mapping install, final F=`1`; current_file=`None`, image/MAC count=`0`
(EX-I3-046-B) outgoing image+A2L A=`7`, I=`4` accepts P-ONLY → final A=`9`, I=`4`, F=`1`, current_file=`None`, phantom MAC/image count=`0`, reset publications=`0`

(EX-I3-047-B) same-path P-PAIR A2L OLD→NEW → final publication contains NEW A2L tags/definitions and a newer A2L generation; unchanged image bytes remain byte-identical while image-stage reinstallation may move image generation; OLD markers=`0`, final F=`1`

(EX-I3-047-C) same-path P-PAIR image OLD→NEW → final publication contains NEW image content and a newer image generation; unchanged A2L bytes remain byte-identical while reset/writer stages may move A2L generation; OLD image markers=`0`, mixed-pair publications=`0`
(EX-I3-047-D) same-path P-ONLY A2L OLD→NEW with prior A=`7`, I=`4` → final A=`9`, I=`4`, NEW A2L publishes once and OLD/no-A2L markers=`0`

(EX-I3-047-E) P-PAIR-NOMAC same-path A2L OLD→NEW with prior A=`7`, I=`4` → final pair `9`, `5` contains NEW A2L and its newer generation; unchanged image bytes remain byte-identical while image reinstall may move image generation; MAC/OLD markers=`0`

(EX-I3-047-F) P-PAIR-NOMAC same-path image OLD→NEW with prior A=`7`, I=`4` → final pair `9`, `5` contains NEW image and its newer generation; unchanged A2L bytes remain byte-identical while reset/writer may move A2L generation; MAC/OLD/mixed markers=`0`

(EX-I3-048-C) current A=`7`, I=`4` and MAC snapshot A2L expectation=`9` instead of required `10` → reject before reset; candidate/cache/session/widget/project/publication mutations=`0`; outcome="Load superseded — current state kept."
(EX-I3-048-D) current A=`7`, I=`4` and MAC snapshot image expectation=`5` instead of required `6` → reject before reset with kept project hashes and the same superseded outcome
(EX-I3-048-E) P-ONLY current A=`7`, I=`4` and snapshot A2L expectation=`8` instead of required `9` → reject before reset/A2L/cache/view/project mutation; success count=`0`
(EX-I3-048-F) P-ONLY snapshot expects `9`, `4`, but live I=`5` at installation requires `9`, `5` → reject the whole candidate before reset even though no image would install

(EX-I3-048-I) P-PAIR captured A=`7`, I=`4`, but live A=`8` before P5 entry makes image/MAC requirements (`10`, `5`)/(`11`, `6`) differ from captured (`9`, `5`)/(`10`, `6`) → reject before reset; L1/candidate/widget/sync/publication calls=`0`

(EX-I3-048-J) P-PAIR captured A=`7`, I=`4`, but live I=`5` before P5 entry makes image/MAC requirements (`9`, `6`)/(`10`, `7`) differ from captured (`9`, `5`)/(`10`, `6`) → reject before reset with previous project hashes equal and no L1 call

(EX-I3-048-K) P-PAIR-NOMAC current A=`7`, I=`4` and image snapshot A2L expectation=`8` instead of required `9` → reject before reset; MAC/L1/candidate/publication calls=`0` and outcome="Load superseded — current state kept."

(EX-I3-048-L) P-PAIR-NOMAC current A=`7`, I=`4` and image snapshot image expectation=`4` instead of required `5` → reject before reset with previous project hashes equal; MAC/L1/candidate/publication/success calls=`0`

entities.name: [Data: Project request]
entities.desc: frozen admission data and UI-captured generations passed from P3 to P4

entities.name: [Data: Prepared project candidate]
entities.desc: frozen prepared bundles, parsed project data and optional A2L-only snapshot passed from P4 to P5

entities.name: [Data: Project session]
entities.desc: current A2L/image/MAC artifacts, both generations, project identity, prepared caches and picker mapping; P5 reads current generations before any write

entities.name: [Data: Project publication]
entities.desc: common A2L-dependent-view publication count; reset and bundle stages publish zero and the single final publication precedes the successful outcome

findings.title: completed Inc2 layering is unavailable at the pinned E1 tree
findings.seen: the corrected Inc2 graph now exists and is lint-clean; this integration phase explicitly performs no product marks/extraction and claims no completed Inc2 product tree
findings.cause: Inc3 has a sequential product dependency on Inc2 even though graph integration can now proceed
findings.effect: graph contracts integrate, but product-layered extraction and runtime verdicts remain outside this phase
findings.decision: CLOSED for E2 graph integration — consume the accepted Inc2 graph/root producer; any later product extraction must use a throwaway clone and rule its findings before E4

findings.title: project preflight must use current UI generations
findings.seen: EX-I3-048-F changes live image generation after the worker snapshot was captured, although the A2L-only candidate installs no image
findings.cause: comparing only with request-captured generations would accept the old image expectation
findings.effect: a captured-only check would violate whole-load stale rejection
findings.decision: CLOSED — P5 derives every required stage pair from current UI counters at installation entry and checks all of them before reset; P1 captures values only for worker preparation

findings.title: same-path project generation wording needs a ruling
findings.seen: corrected REFRESH.047 and project B/C now distinguish changed-artifact generation from byte-identical unchanged content and permit writer/reset/reinstall generation movement
findings.cause: project reload reinstalls the pair through reset and apply stages even when only one artifact's bytes changed
findings.effect: B/C no longer imply an unchanged-artifact generation freeze and the stage matrix remains authoritative
findings.decision: CLOSED — E1 D-6 applies root I-ALP-3; changed content gets a newer generation, unchanged bytes remain identical and stage reinstallation may increment generation

findings.title: project adaptation names and producer call signature remain proposals
findings.seen: root I-ALP-3 now pins captured_a2l_generation/captured_image_generation, P2 image/MAC unions and a2l_only; root I-ALP-2.2 pins the five keyword-only route-neutral producer inputs
findings.cause: the E1 slice defined behavior and defaults while leaving exact adaptation details to E2
findings.effect: incompatible request fields, synthetic LoadedFile/A2LAttachRequest and ambiguous A2L-only calls are excluded
findings.decision: CLOSED — use the root P1/P2/S1 and producer names verbatim; PROP-I3-P-01/02 are accepted and this lane edits no root rule
